description: A Data-driven Analysis of a Cloud Data Center: Statistical Characterization of Workload, Energy and Temperature is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Shashikant Ilager (TU Wien). A characterization of cloud data center logs, analyzing its workload, energy and thermal characteristics. For more details of the dataset, please read the following paper: http://hpc.ec.tuwien.ac.at/files/UCC_23_data_center_analysis.pdf. If you use the dataset, please cite the following work: Shashikant Ilager, Adel N. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
